note: INV-007 SUPPLIED-(block, probeResults) kernel-branch corpus. Drives ReadinessGate.EvaluateReadiness through every INV-005 total-table row with CALLER-SUPPLIED inputs (not the live probes). The INV-007 coverage meta-test enumerates every row id below (a tested const set) and asserts each is present, so dropping a fixture fails the meta-test rather than silently greening. Expected verdict is Pass|Fail; offending names the precondition on Fail.

rows.desc: evidence==null AND declared false AND actual false -> consistent (no fail). Stage-A current state.
evidence==null AND declared true -> Fail (a satisfied claim must cite evidence).
evidence==null AND declared false AND actual true -> Fail (BLOCKED-but-actually-satisfied). The cell that makes the P1 flip mandatory (RS-DC-02).
evidence!=null AND referenceResolution Unresolvable -> hard Fail regardless of status (declared false).
evidence!=null AND referenceResolution Unresolvable -> hard Fail regardless of status (declared true).
evidence!=null AND referenceResolution Malformed -> hard Fail.
evidence!=null AND Resolved -> cross-check declared vs actual; mismatch (declared true, actual false) -> Fail.
status READY legal iff every actual true AND every reference Resolved.
status READY with any actual false -> READY Fail.

status READY with a declared-false + actual-false (CONSISTENT cell) precondition -> READY Fail. The per-cell loop PASSES this cell (declared==actual==false, no lie), so ONLY INV-005's global READY rule catches it -- the forged-READY hole a mini-audit found: a READY block openly declaring a precondition unmet must not pass.
status indeterminate (unparseable, INV-002) -> Fail, and INV-011 ban stays active.
BLOCKED + all probes true (declared false, actual true) -> Fail (BLOCKED-but-actually-satisfied across the set).
satisfied:true + probe-true + UNREGISTERED evidence id -> Fail (evidence-reference registry, RS-RT-05).
